newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Denway shares hit by low offer price.
newsitem.headline: Denway shares hit by low offer price.

text.p: Shares of Denway Investment Ltd fell on Monday after Newsman Overseas Ltd said it planned to make a general offer for the company at a large trading discount, brokers said.
"Selling interest was triggered by the offer price's trading discount of some 40 percent," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage. "The shares are likely to gain support after the gap narrows."
Denway shares fell HK$0.08, or 10.39 percent, to HK$0.69 in mid-morning trade on Monday. Volume was 17.31 million shares.

Newman Overseas said it would make a general offer at HK$0.465 per share for all outstanding Denway shares following completion of its purchase of a 72.8 percent stake in Denway from a unit of Yue Xiu Enterprises (Holdings) Ltd.
The offer price represents a 39.6 percent discount to the closing price of Denway shares on HK$0.77 on January 6, when trading in the shares was suspended.
Newman is indirectly held by Yue Xiu and Guangzhou Jinda Motors Holdings Enterprises.
